notes.title: 0.2.2.2 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're having a great start to the week!

0.2.2.2 is now live and ready for download!

We've managed to pack in new buildings and behaviours along with persistent music volume and the Music Player.

We also buffed a few items such as the Reactors and Life Support Generators to help keep your early settlements away from danger, well, as much as we could ;)

Each new department will support up to 5000 people before it becomes ineffective. Once you are over 5000 people then the positive value of the department will become a negative decrease...look out for those riots!

[b][u]The new buildings include...[/u][/b]

[olist]
[*] Police Department - will reduce your crime daily by 1 point
[*] Health Department - This will increase the general health of the colony 1 point per day
[*] Fire Department - This will increase the health and happiness of the colony but will feature in new improvements coming in later releases
[*] Education Department - This will increase your education by 1 point per day. Education will become a decisive factor in coming releases so dont neglect it!
[/olist]
[b][u]Additional Buildings[/u][/b]

There are some additional buildings being added but currently lack the back-end influence/impact that they will have in later releases. These will be released in the new few weeks as part of the 0.3 release.
[olist]
[*] Spy Network - This will help warn you of any impending revolutions or terrorist attacks
[*] Refinery - This will be a major feature of the resource management and economy gameplay allowing you to combine resources to make alloys & high end metals
[*] Logistics Depot - This will provide a home for your logistics transports which will tie in with the Shipyard coming in the next release.
[/olist]

We hope you all have a great rest of the week!
Take care!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you're all having a great week!

We're just finalising a minor update for 0.2.2.1, this includes some UI fixes, additional buttons in preparation for 0.2.2.2. This should be released in the next few hours.

We have now added the starting implementation for Fire & Rescue services along with the Refinery. While these buildings are not yet in-game the inital button positioning is now completed.

Both these items are due to be released in 0.2.2.3. along with Police, Health and Education departments.

We also added in further Events such as the food shortage/famine to accompany the many dangers and requests looming around the universe.

The biggest noticeable update in this small update is the Notifcations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35935572/45912ca575a932576efb94919086147952bfc7aa.png[/img]

You will now receive updates when a planet's resources are running low, this will help you take action before things get "too crazy" ;)

Have a great rest of the week!

notes.title: 0.2.2.1 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

So here comes our first patch of the EA release, this includes new UI improvements & tutorial updates to help explain the mechanics of the game.

Here is the change log....

1. Updated Capital Confirmation text - removed some duplicate words
2. Added Notification when buildings are bought 
3. Updated Purchase Buildings Accept & Cancel buttons to be more clearer
4. Updated main text colours
5. Updated Save/Load Menu UI
6. Updated Production Line Item Selection
7. Added more tutorial/help pages 

More updates will be coming soon!

Thanks
CSD
